name: Threat Modelling and Risk
summary: Finding the flaw in the design costs a meeting; finding it in production costs an incident. Model before you build.
prerequisites: Requires secure coding. It is done before the code exists, which is what makes it cheap.
syllabus: Modelling the threat before writing code
Continuous modelling, not a dead document

topics.title: What threat modelling is and when to do it
Data flow diagrams and trust boundaries
STRIDE: spoofing, tampering, repudiation, information disclosure, denial of service and elevation of privilege
An overview of DREAD, LINDDUN and attack trees
Attack surface mapping: inputs, outputs and dependencies
From identified risk to security requirement
Risk quantification: likelihood, impact and expected value
An overview of FAIR and qualitative matrices
Prioritisation: risk versus the cost of mitigation
Recording decisions and formal risk acceptance
Control mapping: ISO 27001, NIST CSF and SOC 2
Continuous modelling: folding it into refinement and design review
